build_linear_crf_model: build a linear-chain CRF model with potentials and transitions graphs for sequence labeling
create_transition_graph: create a bigram transition graph for a CRF with a specified number of classes
create_potential_graph: create a unary potential graph mapping input features to output classes in a CRF
sample_crf_model: sample sequences from a trained linear-chain CRF model using Viterbi decoding
compute_crf_loss: compute the negative log-likelihood loss for a CRF given input and target sequences
